stable.releaseNotes: Adds bounded rolling backup retention: full backups max 3 / 90 days with automatic 30-day refresh, resolved system-update rollbacks max 3 / 30 days, restore-safety max 2 / 30 days, and automatic pre-change backups max 50 / 30 days. Interrupted update recovery blocks another install until resolved. No workspace migration.

beta.releaseNotes: Next Beta baseline carrying forward Stable 0.10.13 bounded backup retention and update-recovery install guard. No workspace migration.
